title: Selling Plans Fee Operations Worksheet — Chargeback Credit Amount
content:
This worksheet computes the chargeback credit booked on a **Selling Plans** plan's variable final value fee record when a buyer's chargeback is debited to the seller's Northloop Payments account.

## Computation

**Order.** The order worked on is the order of the most recent chargeback debit on the seller's payments account. Its variable final value fee record — its amount billed, fee basis and billing date — is the one credited.

**Formula in words.** The chargeback credit is the creditable variable fee times the chargeback share, rounded to the nearest cent, less the chargeback administration fee. The creditable variable fee of a chargeback credit is the variable final value fee billed on the order less every credit already booked on that fee record, administration fees included, and never below zero. The chargeback share is the chargeback amount debited for the order divided by the order's fee basis, never above one. The chargeback administration fee is the chargeback credit before the fee times the refund administration fee rate, rounded to the nearest cent, and capped at the refund administration fee cap.

| Line | Quantity | How it is reached |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Variable fee billed | From the order's variable final value fee record |
| 2 | Credits already booked | Every credit on that fee record counted before any administration fee was withheld — administration fees included |
| 3 | Creditable variable fee | Line 1 less line 2, never below zero |
| 4 | Chargeback share | The chargeback debits for the order added together, divided by the order's fee basis, never above one |
| 5 | Credit before the fee | Line 3 times line 4, rounded to the nearest cent |
| 6 | Chargeback administration fee | Line 5 times the plan's refund administration fee rate, rounded to the nearest cent, then held to the plan's refund administration fee cap |
| 7 | Chargeback credit | Line 5 less line 6 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs; a rate of 20% and a cap of USD 5.00)

| Line | Case A | Case B |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | USD 40.00 | USD 100.00 |
| 2 | USD 0.00 | USD 0.00 |
| 3 | USD 40.00 | USD 100.00 |
| 4 | 150.00 over a fee basis of 300.00: 0.5 | 600.00 over a fee basis of 500.00: capped at one |
| 5 | USD 20.00 | USD 100.00 |
| 6 | 20% of 20.00 is USD 4.00, under the cap | 20% of 100.00 is USD 20.00, held to USD 5.00 |
| 7 | USD 16.00 | USD 95.00 |

The figures on lines 5, 6 and 7 are the three amounts a chargeback credit record shows: the credit before the fee, the fee withheld and the credit given.
